newsitem.title: CANADA: TD Bank raises 1997 loan loss provision.
newsitem.headline: TD Bank raises 1997 loan loss provision.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Thursday it raised its 1997 loan loss provision to C$160 million from C$152 million in 1996 and charged C$40 million of the loss to the first quarter.

Toronto-Dominion said net impaired loans increased to C$514 million at January 31, 1997 from C$344 million at October 31, 1996. It said the increase was largely due to a decline in credit quality on corporate loans to the forestry sector and partially offset by an improvement in real estate loans to corporate borrowers.
Net impaired loans as a percentage of total loans and bankers' acceptances increased slightly from 0.4% last quarter to 0.5% this quarter.
